name: Lumbini, the Birthplace of the Lord Buddha
description: Lumbini, in southern Nepal's Rupandehi District, is the garden where Siddhartha Gautama, the future Buddha, is said to have been born to Queen Maya. Pilgrims come to see the Mayadevi Temple, the sacred pond where the infant was first bathed, and a pillar raised by Emperor Ashoka. Monasteries funded by Buddhist communities from many countries dot the surrounding grounds.
